Homeowner service request terms

Updated October 7, 2026 · Request notice version 2026-10-07.

Your request

Submitting lawn-care details asks Mow Matter to review availability and contact you about the inquiry. It creates no payment, subscription, binding lawn-service contract or confirmed booking. A date preference is not an accepted service date.

Your provider and price

Independent operators perform lawn care. Before enrollment, your provider must confirm their identity and contact, service scope, price/taxes, visit frequency, first window, access requirements and cancellation/refund policy. Approve any changed scope or additional charge before work.

Service responsibility

Your service agreement is with the identified operator. Contact that operator about quality, weather changes, missed visits or property damage. Mow Matter can facilitate communication without becoming the lawn contractor. Mandatory legal rights remain unaffected.

Property and access

Only request work at property you are authorized to manage. Identify pets and hazards. Do not send gate codes, card details or passwords through the public inquiry form. Photos should document approved work, not unrelated people or interiors.

Quotes, payment and cancellation

Instant estimates require property and scope confirmation. Biweekly and twice-monthly service are different schedules. Current completed-visit payment links do not authorize future recurring card charges. Any future autopay needs a separate clear authorization and cancellation process. Operator cancellation and refund terms must be disclosed before booking.

Contact and privacy

Request-related contact is separate from promotional marketing. Read the Privacy Policy for how addresses and contact details are handled. Submit platform or privacy inquiries through the contact/request page. You may change optional marketing preferences without cancelling your service inquiry.
